The Working Families Tax Cuts are an investment in American families. Here's what @SenateGOP did:

- Expanded the Child Tax Credit to $2,200 a kid
- Increased the Child and Dependent Tax Credit from 25% to 50%
- Provided a tax deduction from $5,000 to up to $7,500 for dependent care.

These are real investments that allow Nebraskan families to keep more of their hard-earned money.

-Cut red tape and enhance efficiency in homebuilding
-Improve the quality and accessibility of housing for our seniors and those with disabilities
-Expand homeownership options for hard-working, middle-income Americans
-Help veterans become homeowners

We need to get this bill signed into law.  It will continue building the Good Life
